summary_1line: Bhishma praises the gift of food and heavenly rewards, then begins Narada’s teaching on auspicious star-based times and offerings for charitable gifts.

image_candidates.scene_text: Celestial palaces shining like moons and suns rise in heaven, surrounded by rivers of milk and mountains of rice for those who gave food in life.
The Sun draws moisture from the earth while the wind lifts it to clouds that pour rain back upon the waiting fields.
Devaki respectfully questions the wandering sage Narada in the city of Dwaraka as he begins explaining gifts under different constellations.
